description: This file defines an abstract class 'ReportDataAPI' in the OrangeHRM project, serving as a REST API endpoint for fetching report data. It includes methods for retrieving all report data with validation and access control, and stubs for create and delete operations that are not implemented. The class uses traits, references to other API components, and is part of the core API namespace.

classes.name: ReportDataAPI
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a REST API endpoint for report data, providing methods for retrieving report data with validation and access control, adhering to the CollectionEndpoint interface.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all report data after performing accessibility checks and validation, returning a collection result.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the associated report object; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: getReportName
methods.description: Returns the report name parameter value from the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' operation, initialized with report name validation.

methods.name: getReportNameParamRule
methods.description: Creates a validation rule for the report name parameter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Stub method for creating resources, throws Not Implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Stub method for create validation, throws Not Implemented exception.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Stub method for deleting resources, throws Not Implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Stub method for delete validation, throws Not Implemented exception.
